/// A packed 128-bit integer. Useful for reducing the size of structures in
/// some cases.
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, Hash, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
#[repr(packed(8))]
pub struct Pu128(pub u128);

impl Pu128 {
    #[inline]
    pub fn get(self) -> u128 {
        self.0
    }
}
